scope: Shared converter/writer conservative memory accounting and explicit independent synthesis/replay caps
contracts: Shared cap accepts external=60 plus writer=40 at cap=100, rejects writer=41, retains peak after release, rejects u64 overflow
Cached three-weight conversion emits one synthesis step but replays three: cap=2 fails at flat index 2 without publication, cap=3 succeeds
Creation, catalog growth, block replay and final verification include importer reservations
Importer cache and mapped reader are dropped before final verification; pending vectors release capacity on flush
limitations: Memory is accounted owned working-set estimates, not process RSS; mapped pages and allocator overhead are excluded.
Synthesis and replay counters independently obey the declared cap; synthesis_steps reports synthesis only.
No CLI, real-model inference or full mutation-campaign completion is claimed.
